article.text: EnviroGets for Environmental Consulting & Services is a leading provider of environmental consulting and services in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Established in 2015 under the name Gulf Environmental Technology for Environmental Services (GETES), the organization has consistently delivered professional environmental services. It later evolved its corporate identity and rebranded as EnviroGets, reflecting its forward-looking vision and expanding range of services, while preserving the expertise and professional legacy built over the years.

EnviroGets is licensed by the National Center for Environmental Compliance (NCEC), Category (A), and provides integrated environmental solutions through a specialized team of experts and consultants, supporting environmental compliance, sustainability, and responsible development across the Kingdom.

The organization operates an ISO/IEC 17025-accredited laboratory for water and soil analysis, equipped with advanced technologies to ensure accurate and reliable results. In addition, EnviroGets operates a specialized Air Quality and Noise Monitoring Laboratory, utilizing measurement and calibration equipment in accordance with national and international standards to provide accurate and reliable data that supports sound environmental decision-making.

Driven by its commitment to scientific excellence and innovation, EnviroGets continues to deliver reliable and advanced environmental solutions that contribute to environmental protection, promote sustainability, and support the achievement of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia’s Vision 2030 objectives.

scrollData.title: Our Mission
text: Our vision is to lead the future of environmental services in Saudi Arabia by delivering innovative, science-based environmental solutions that support sustainability, protect natural resources, and enhance quality of life.

We aspire to be the trusted environmental partner for the public and private sectors, providing reliable data, specialized laboratory services, and expert consulting that enable informed decisions and strengthen environmental compliance.
Through our commitment to innovation and environmental responsibility, we contribute to achieving the objectives of Saudi Vision 2030 and building a more sustainable future for generations to come.

scrollData.title: Our Vision
text: At EnviroGets, we are committed to innovation and continuous development to deliver effective, integrated environmental solutions that support sustainability, strengthen environmental compliance, and protect natural resources.

We execute our projects with the highest standards of quality, efficiency, and reliability, while adhering to applicable environmental regulations and ensuring accurate measurements and laboratory results.
Through advanced technologies and best practices, we strive to create lasting value for our clients and contribute to the objectives of Saudi Vision 2030 and sustainable development.

soilTypes.title: Types of Analyses Performed on Soil Samples

text.title: Chemical Analysis
text: Includes a comprehensive range of chemical tests to assess soil quality and detect contaminants, including organic compounds such as BTEX, PAHs, and TPH, as well as heavy metals and toxic elements. Tests also cover pH, organic matter, essential nutrients, and dissolved salts. These analyses help assess soil contamination and determine its suitability for environmental, agricultural, and industrial applications.

text.title: Physical Analysis
text: Includes the assessment of soil physical properties such as moisture content, bulk and particle density, and particle size distribution (sand, silt, and clay), as well as permeability, soil texture, and water-holding capacity. These tests provide essential data to support geotechnical, hydrological, and agricultural studies.

text.title: Biological Analysis
text: Includes the examination and assessment of microorganisms and biological activity in soil to evaluate soil health and its ability to support ecosystems and plant growth. It also contributes to detecting biological contamination, assessing the impact of pollutants on microorganisms, and supporting soil remediation programs and sustainable natural resource management.

content.title: KJO – South Area
content.slug: أعمال المسح والتقييم البيئي لماده الأسبستوس KJO – South Area
text: EnviroGets’ technical team carried out an environmental survey and assessment of asbestos-containing materials in petroleum pipelines as part of the Khafji Joint Operations (KJO) Project. The work was conducted in accordance with applicable environmental best practices, the requirements of the National Center for Environmental Compliance (NCEC), and international occupational health and safety standards.

​The scope of work included a comprehensive field environmental survey to identify the locations of Thermal System Insulation (TSI) and gaskets suspected of containing asbestos fibers, assess their physical condition, and evaluate the potential risk of fiber release. In accordance with approved environmental protocols, field samples were collected using the wet method to minimize the release of airborne asbestos fibers, with full personal protective equipment (PPE) and complete work-area containment measures implemented.

​The documentation process included transporting samples under a secure Chain of Custody system for accredited laboratory analysis using Polarized Light Microscopy (PLM) to identify asbestos types and determine their percentage composition. The generated waste was also classified to establish appropriate safe handling and disposal pathways.

These measures provide a critical foundation for developing an Asbestos Management & Abatement Plan and ensuring the final disposal of hazardous waste at approved disposal facilities, supporting the highest standards of environmental protection, site safety, and sustainability.
